name: Apply Transformations to Multiple Tractography Files
summary: Applies an ANTs affine and nonlinear warp to every .tck file in a tract collection with scilpy, moving streamlines from the registration's moving space into the reference space.
description: Loops over all .tck files of a neuro/tcks collection and runs applyTransformations2tract.sh on each, composing the affine and selected warp and applying them with scilpy inside the gamorosino/tract_align container. Use it to bring a set of bundles into another subject or template space after a T1w, T2w or FA registration. It needs at least one moving-space image and one reference-space image. Note: fsl_transform is not read by main, so FSL transforms are not converted.

inputs.description: Collection of tractograms (.tck files) in the moving space of the registration.
Registration transform: ANTs affine plus forward warp and inverse warp.
Moving-space T1w image (the space the tractogram is in); first choice for the moving image.
Moving-space T2w image; used as moving image if no T1w is given.
Moving-space tensor maps; FA is used as moving image if no T1w or T2w is given.
Reference (target) space T1w image; first choice for the reference image.
Reference-space T2w image; used if no fixed T1w is given.
Reference-space tensor maps; FA is used as reference if no fixed T1w or T2w is given.

outputs.description: The collection of transformed .tck files, in the reference space.

parameters.description:
Assume registration was performed as:

    MOVING  →  REFERENCE

This means the estimated transform maps MOVING space into REFERENCE space.


Bring tractogram FROM MOVING → REFERENCE space
 (default true)

Assume registration was performed as:

    MOVING  →  REFERENCE

This means the estimated transform maps MOVING space into REFERENCE space.
Bring tractogram FROM REFERENCE → MOVING space

 (default false)
If true, converts affine and warp to from FSL to ANTs-compatible format

citations.text: Amorosino G, Olivetti E, Jovicich J, Avesani P. How Does White Matter Registration Affect Tractography Alignment? IEEE ISBI (2023).
Hayashi S, et al. Brainlife.io: a decentralized platform for reproducible neuroscience. Nature Methods (2024).

failure_modes.message: Error: No valid moving image found in config.json
failure_modes.fix: Provide one of t1w, t2w or tensor (moving space).

failure_modes.message: Error: No valid fixed/reference image found in config.json
failure_modes.fix: Provide one of t1w_fixed, t2w_fixed or tensor_fixed (reference space).

failure_modes.message: Error: forward_operation and reverse_operation cannot both be true.
failure_modes.fix: Enable only one of the two.
